meta.phase-name: Shared Level Schema and Codegen Implementation

phase-plan.purpose: Start the actual implementation work for phase 58 by turning the approved level-centered world model into shared schema documents, neutral codegen outputs, and import/export flow that the game and later plugin work can consume.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: engine-side schema document shapes for levels and nested structures, generated neutral outputs, project/test-mode import/export flow, and planning alignment for downstream docs-site and gameplay integration. Out of scope: full docs-site editor UI, full gameplay migration, and Unreal plugin UI implementation.
phase-plan.definition-of-done: Done when the repo has the shared level-centered schema contract, generated neutral outputs, checked-in level-content source docs, release payload generation, and import/export support wired into the active content-pack flow.

file.description: Approved concrete model for level kinds, nesting, and Unreal browsing.
Current shared schema, import/export, generated-output, and overlay baseline from phase 56.
Primary implementation surface for shared schema docs and neutral codegen outputs.
Import/export and authored content flow surface that must stay aligned with the new schema outputs.

task.description: Define the concrete shared schema document shapes for levels, towns, districts, buildings, rooms, sites, and connections.
Define the neutral generated outputs required by the game and later Unreal browser workflow.
Map the schema and outputs onto the current phase-56 import/export and generated-output pipeline.

implementation-targets.target: Shared level-centered schema lives alongside the generic schema baseline instead of in a parallel ad hoc system.
Generated outputs remain neutral and reusable across Escape the Dungeon, the later DungeonBreak extension, and the Unreal browser workflow.
Import/export stays usable in test mode without forcing a database requirement.
